biotools.summary: coADAPTr is an open-source R package designed for automated data analysis in covalent labeling mass spectrometry, particularly hydroxyl radical protein footprinting (HRPF). It simplifies and accelerates data processing, offering improved fidelity and throughput compared to traditional methods like Excel’s Power Pivot.
